After-Hours Stock Movers 07/31: (MOH) (TCS) (AAPL) Higher; (BGFV) (ZAGG) (MB) Lower (more...) July 31, 2018 6:23 PM Today's After-Hours Movers Molina Healthcare (NYSE: MOH ) 17.2% HIGHER ; reported Q2 EPS of $3.02, versus $1.64 reported last year. Premium revenue for the quarter came in at $4.88 billion versus the consensus estimate of $4.67 billion. Molina Healthcare sees FY2018 Adj. EPS of $7.39-$7.59, sees FY 2018 premium revenue of $17.5 billion and total revenue of $18.8 billion.
Big 5 Sporting Goods (NASDAQ: BGFV ) 15.5% LOWER ; reported Q2 EPS of ($0.01), versus $0.13 reported last year. Revenue for the quarter came in at $239.95 million, versus $243.67 million reported last year. ​Same store sales decreased 2.1% for the second quarter of fiscal 2018, compared to a 0.9% increase in same store sales for the second quarter of fiscal 2017.

Revenue for the quarter came in at $128.8 million versus the consensus estimate of $124.35 million. Paycom Software sees Q3 2018 revenue of $129-131 million, versus the consensus of $127.43 million.
